userStories.title: Implement module deletion with cascade except hierarchy
userStories.description: Create a function in module_repository.py to delete a module and all its related entities (bounding_contour, streams, platforms, boundaries) but preserve parent and child modules in the hierarchy. Remove associations without deleting the modules themselves. Use SQLAlchemy cascade options or manual deletion.
acceptanceCriteria: Deleting a module removes all related entities except parent/child modules
Parent-child associations are removed but modules stay
Full unit test passes for the deletion functionality
userStories.notes: Implemented delete_module method in ModuleRepository. Deletes bounding_contour, ModuleBoundary entities, removes associations to streams/platforms/boundaries/parent-child, preserves parent/child modules. Unit tests pass.

userStories.title: Implement file (brep_string) hash check for module updates
userStories.description: In the module update process, before committing changes, calculate hash of current files and compare with previous version hash. If hashes differ, proceed with update; if same, skip. Implement hash function using hashlib.sha256 on file contents.
acceptanceCriteria: Hash calculation function exists in git_manager.py or similar
Update logic checks hash before proceeding
Full unit test passes for hash checking

userStories.title: Create unit tests with DB mocks for untested services
userStories.description: Write comprehensive unit tests using pytest and unittest.mock for the following services: module_copier, brep_storage, git_manager, web_soket_server, basic_object_extractor. Mock database sessions and external dependencies. Ensure 100% coverage for critical methods.
acceptanceCriteria: Unit test files exist for each untested service
All tests use mocked DB sessions
pytest runs without errors and all tests pass

userStories.title: Add delete button with confirmation modal to module details page
userStories.description: Implement delete button on basic_object_details.html that opens a confirmation modal. Modal should confirm deletion before calling the delete API endpoint. Ensure deletion does not affect parent/child modules.
acceptanceCriteria: Modal appears on button click with confirmation message
API delete endpoint called only after confirmation
